mapper.select: SELECT r.*, usk.kwd_no, usk.name AS keyword_name, usk.study_level FROM RESERVATION r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sk.*, ik.name FROM SELECTED_KEYWORD sk JOIN INTEREST_KEYWORD ik ON sk.kwd_no = ik.no ) AS usk ON usk.rsv_email = r.email ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

SELECT r.*, usk.kwd_no, usk.name AS keyword_name, usk.study_level FROM RESERVATION r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sk.*, ik.name FROM SELECTED_KEYWORD sk JOIN INTEREST_KEYWORD ik ON sk.kwd_no = ik.no ) AS usk ON usk.rsv_email = r.email WHERE r.email = #{email} AND password = #{password}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION (email, user_ip, password, name, phone, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{userIp}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, now())
